integration_discoveries.symptom: The checked text runtime rejected a fixture URL containing query-string characters before any task input.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: All three arms must navigate the same task URL through the admitted runtime.
integration_discoveries.repair: Encode task identity as a path segment accepted by the existing bounded text alphabet.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: audit_integrated_efficiency_runtime_probe_v1.py retains probe-01 and verifies corrected probe-02.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The engineering A field point used display-scaled y=177 instead of the exact 1280x800 source-frame y near 401, producing a flat patch refusal.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: Engineering mechanics must use points expressed in the exact source observation frame.
integration_discoveries.repair: Inspect exact source pixels and use A field/submit points [226,401]/[376,401].
integration_discoveries.regression_test: audit_integrated_efficiency_persistent_mechanics_v1.py retains mechanics-01 and verifies later A mints.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The task-4 MISSING handle record correctly omitted a resolution sequence, while the probe packaging indexed it as mandatory and raised KeyError.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: Typed refusal packaging must preserve a missing optional field without converting safe refusal into runner failure.
integration_discoveries.repair: Record sequence as optional with get() for non-resolving handle outcomes.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: audit_integrated_efficiency_persistent_mechanics_v1.py verifies the retained mechanics-02 MISSING event and later nullable sequence report.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The 30px-tall layout-B field left a 24x22 center patch entirely white, so target minting safely refused it as visually flat.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: One declared field-region rule must remain discriminative across both frozen layouts.
integration_discoveries.repair: Use a fixed 24x38 field region in both layouts so the model point neighborhood includes the visible field boundary.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: audit_integrated_efficiency_persistent_mechanics_v1.py retains mechanics-03 and verifies B mint/reuse in mechanics-05.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The successful mechanics-04 report searched for pointer_target_admission while raw runtime events use pointer_admission, falsely reporting zero intended admissions.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: The comparison ledger must reconcile every consequential pointer admission to raw events.
integration_discoveries.repair: Count pointer_admission and require exactly one button_down for each of twelve intended target-action programs.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: audit_integrated_efficiency_persistent_mechanics_v1.py proves mechanics-04's reporting mismatch and mechanics-05's reconciled count.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The first comparison protocol rejected duplicate call IDs only within one task and could accept the same ID in two tasks.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: All attempted model calls must have unique IDs across the complete three-arm allocation.
integration_discoveries.repair: Maintain one global call-ID set while validating every arm and task.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The ephemeral arm composed task-1 into a target alias, but the handle registry permits only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: Every arm must derive bounded private aliases without weakening the registry grammar.
integration_discoveries.repair: Normalize non-alphanumeric prefix characters to underscores, require a leading letter and cap the prefix before adding the field/submit suffix.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: probe_integrated_efficiency_three_arm_mechanics_v1.py retains mechanics-01 and reruns all three arms with normalized aliases.

integration_discoveries.symptom: The composed runner read the exported submission-history path after each task, but the runtime materializes that artifact only at finish, so all 18 successful submissions were provisionally counted as zero.
integration_discoveries.blocking_requirement: Each task row must reconcile exact independent submissions without assuming an internal fixture path is live during the episode.
integration_discoveries.repair: After the independent finish event, reconcile the exported append-only history back to the already recorded task rows by task ID and preserve the original task timing/source records.
integration_discoveries.regression_test: probe_integrated_efficiency_live_orchestration_v1.py retains probe-01 and requires probe-02 to report all three independent six-task sequences correct through the formal runner.
